answer.worked: $x\times x^2=x^{1+2}=x^3$: add exponents when multiplying powers with the same base.

blocks.alt: Original handwritten student working for analysis

inlines.text: Why did Mora add the exponents instead of multiplying them?

answer.worked: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents: $x^2\times x^2=x^{2+2}=x^4$.
